capabilities: Normalize Markdown headings, lists, blank lines, code blocks and tables
Compact Markdown by removing redundant blank lines without merging paragraphs
Re-indent JSON with two spaces while preserving literals verbatim
Minify JSON to a single line
Normalize unusual whitespace characters outside JSON strings
extras: Runs locally with no network requests or runtime dependencies. Documents larger than 2 MB are skipped. Known gaps: CJK characters count as width 1 so all-Chinese tables do not align, tables inside blockquotes are not aligned, and a fence indented 4 spaces inside a list item is not treated as protected. JSON formatting on a whole Markdown note fails by design; select the JSON fragment first.
problem: Markdown notes and pasted JSON accumulate inconsistent heading spacing, list markers, blank lines and indentation that Obsidian does not clean up on its own.
summary: Formatting plugin that normalizes or compacts Markdown structure and pretty-prints or minifies JSON in the current note or selection.
